title: Settings
subtitle: Preferences that apply across the whole app.

webSearch.title: Web Search
webSearch.description: Sets whether web search starts on or off for new conversations, on every model with no value saved with /config global. Each conversation keeps its own web search switch in /config afterwards, so changing this setting never affects a conversation that already exists.
webSearch.note: Off by default. When a tool-capable model decides to search, the searched query is sent to external search engines — nothing else leaves your machine.

reasoningEffort.title: Default reasoning effort
reasoningEffort.description: Sets the starting reasoning effort for new conversations, on every model with no level saved with /config global. Each conversation keeps its own level in /config and /effort afterwards, so changing this setting never affects a conversation that already exists.
reasoningEffort.note: Medium by default. Higher levels let the model deliberate more before answering; None asks it to answer directly.

compactionThreshold.title: Default compaction threshold
compactionThreshold.description: Sets the starting compaction threshold for new conversations, on every model with no threshold saved with /config global: older messages are summarized when a conversation fills this share of the model's context window. Each conversation keeps its own threshold in /config afterwards, so changing this setting never affects a conversation that already exists.
compactionThreshold.note: 80% by default. Lower: summarizes sooner and more often, keeping the conversation shorter. Higher: keeps more of it word for word and summarizes less often.

idleUnload.title: Unload the model when idle
idleUnload.description: An unused model leaves memory after this delay, which frees it for your other apps, and reloads at your next message. The delay counts from the model's last answer and applies at once, without restarting Erudi.
idleUnload.note: 5 minutes by default. Never keeps the model loaded however long it stays unused; the model is still unloaded when your computer runs short of memory, and the Unload button in a conversation's settings unloads it at any time. The knowledge-base search model has its own delay.

updatePreferences.title: Updates
updatePreferences.description: What Erudi does on its own when a new version is published. The Update Erudi card below checks, downloads and installs on demand, whatever you choose here.

check.label: Check for updates
check.help: Asks this project's GitHub releases for a new version at launch, then every 4 hours, and shows a banner when there is one. The request carries nothing but your version and platform.

download.label: Download updates automatically
download.help: As soon as the check finds a new version, Erudi fetches the installer in the background. When off, the banner offers a Download button and nothing is fetched until you press it.

install.label: Install downloaded updates when I quit
install.help: A downloaded version replaces the app when you quit Erudi, without a dialog. When off, it waits for Install now.

updatePreferences.checkOffNote: Turn on Check for updates to use the two other switches.
updatePreferences.handedOffNote: This update may still install when you quit: macOS has already received it.

updates.title: Update Erudi
updates.description: Look for a new version now, download it and install it straight away. Installing closes Erudi and opens it again on the new version.
updates.upToDate: You are on the latest version.
updates.failed: The update could not be checked right now. Try again in a moment.
updates.unavailable: Updates are handled by the installed application; this build cannot check for them.

language.title: Application language
language.description: The language of menus, buttons and messages across the whole app. Model answers stay in whatever language you write in.
language.note: Applied immediately and remembered for the next launch. Set from your system language on first launch.

privacy.title: What leaves your machine
privacy.description: Models run on this computer and your conversations and documents stay on it. The page lists every network request the app can make, when it happens, and the code that proves it.

inferenceBackend.title: Inference engine
inferenceBackend.description: Choose whether Erudi runs models on the graphics card or on the processor. Automatic uses the graphics card whenever the driver supports it.
inferenceBackend.note: Erudi restarts its engine when this changes. The processor is slower but sidesteps the graphics card entirely.
